# GPT-Vis

> GPT-Vis is an open-source browser visualization library for AI agents and applications. This site documents the 1.x API.

Install the JavaScript/TypeScript SDK with npm install @antv/gpt-vis. Create a GPTVis instance for a container, call render() with JSON or Syntax, and call destroy() when finished. Custom theme objects require 1.3.0 or later; pass them through the theme option.

The chart-visualization Agent Skill supports chart selection, configurations, integration code, and themes. The skills installer installs this Skill; GPT-Vis does not ship a separate drawing CLI. The AntV chart MCP server is maintained separately.

Built-in gallery theme names are gpt-vis, midnight, paper, product, neon-circuit, terra-print, mono-signal, candy-pop, pop, and bauhaus. Pass a name through the theme option in constructor options, chart JSON, or Syntax. The legacy default (alias light), dark, and academy themes keep their existing appearance. For customized themes, pass the complete JSON object; a custom id does not register a name. The caller supplies data and analysis results.

## Documentation

- [Introduction](https://gpt-vis.antv.vision/docs): Charts for AI agents and applications.
- [Agent Skill](https://gpt-vis.antv.vision/docs/agent-skill): Install the skill and create your first chart with your agent.
- [SDK quickstart](https://gpt-vis.antv.vision/docs/quickstart): Install GPT-Vis and render a chart in JavaScript or TypeScript.
- [JSON & Syntax](https://gpt-vis.antv.vision/docs/syntax): Describe charts with structured JSON or readable Syntax.
- [Chart types](https://gpt-vis.antv.vision/docs/charts): Find a chart for your data and explore its options.
- [Streaming rendering](https://gpt-vis.antv.vision/docs/streaming): Update a chart as model output arrives.
- [Themes & styles](https://gpt-vis.antv.vision/docs/themes): Apply a shared theme to charts, graphs, tables, and summaries.
- [Chart styling](https://gpt-vis.antv.vision/docs/styles): Override one chart and understand how local styles affect shared themes.
- [React & Vue](https://gpt-vis.antv.vision/docs/integrations/frameworks): Mount, update, and destroy charts in your framework.
- [Markdown](https://gpt-vis.antv.vision/docs/integrations/markdown): Render visualization code fences in Markdown content.
- [shadcn/ui](https://gpt-vis.antv.vision/docs/integrations/shadcn): Copy typed React chart components into your application.
- [MCP & ecosystem](https://gpt-vis.antv.vision/docs/integrations/ecosystem): Connect chart tools and explore related packages.
- [Theme configuration](https://gpt-vis.antv.vision/docs/reference/theme-spec): Shared tokens, supported style blocks, and chart-specific theme overrides.
- [GPTVis API](https://gpt-vis.antv.vision/docs/reference/api): Constructor options, rendering, and instance cleanup.

## Interactive tools

- [Theme Studio](https://gpt-vis.antv.vision/themes): Create, import, preview, and export theme JSON.
- [Examples](https://gpt-vis.antv.vision/examples): Live chart examples and supported chart options.
- [Skill source](https://github.com/antvis/GPT-Vis/tree/ai/skills/chart-visualization).
